integrity: Analytic stationary Gaussian mixture and sharp saddle proof; standalone 31-check numerical corroboration; no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Full simultaneous Poisson resets; independent Gaussian driving noise; linear shear; fixed effective shear and direction in tail limit. No partial-reset, joint multidimensional-moment, nonlinear-flow or uniform zero-shear result.
title: A directional moment-determinacy boundary for shear diffusion under resetting
